error.captcha_service: The browser service could not be used: check the API key, or whether any units are left this month.
error.captcha_unsolved: Google put up an image challenge and the service did not solve it. Try again in a few minutes.
error.too_soon: A login was attempted very recently. Wait a while, or restart Home Assistant.
error.need_token_or_key: Enter either an OAuth token or a browser service API key.

user.title: Setup integration
user.description: With a key, the integration solves the login captcha itself and renews the token when it expires. Your credentials never leave Home Assistant: the remote service only mints the captcha. Browserless gives 1000 free units a month; a login usually spends 11 or 12, and up to 14 when Google takes its time over the challenge. Without a key, you have to paste the token by hand.

token.title: Provide user OAuth Token
token.description:

data.token: OAuth Token (leave empty if you provide an API key)

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: Paste a fresh token to carry on by hand, or enter a browser service API key and the integration will get its own from now on, so this form stops coming back. Your credentials never leave Home Assistant: the remote service only mints the captcha.
